notes.title: New Stage: 2025
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans! ːfofinoː

What if arcades had never disappeared? What would the world look like today? Would you be anxiously searching for quarters just to find more kittens?

Before we started developing our own games, we were simply passionate fans of indie games. This update is a tribute to some of the games that have shaped our journey! ːsansː

This homage is also the biggest level in the game so far, featuring a brand-new ending to discover! 

Are you ready to dive into our alternative future where cats and indie games rule the arcade scene? ːkleinesː

Arcade Full of Cats: Timewarp Trouble Update is live now! ːpapyruswackyː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: A New Stage is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!  ːcathspawː

We’ve got some pawsome news for you! While our plan was to celebrate the 1st anniversary of [b]An Arcade Full of Cats[/b] with a big update, life threw us a curveball (or should we say, a yarn ball)! 
But don’t worry—this exciting update is now set to launch early next year! ːwinkycatː

The update will feature a brand-new level for the [b]TimeWarp Trouble[/b] DLC—[b]MUCH bigger[/b] than the others, complete with [b]its own unique ending[/b]! It’s shaping up to be the biggest, most thrilling scenario in the entire game. And while we’re keeping the theme a mystery for now... trust us, it’ll be worth the wait! ːsansː

After the Winter Sale, the game’s price will increase to $3. But here’s the good news: if you already own the DLC, you’ll get this update for free! 

And don’t forget—[b]A Shelter Full of Cats[/b], the latest game in our “Full of Cats” series, has just launched!  This one is extra special to us, and we hope you'll enjoy it too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3087650/A_Shelter_Full_of_Cats/

Stay tunad for more updates, and thank you so much for your continued support! ːfofino2ː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: New Stage: 3000 BC
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans! ːcathspawː

We are thrilled to announce the latest update to "An Arcade Full of Cats: Timewarp Trouble"! Let's travel through space and time once more with Leo and Fofiño to a brand new stage, set way back in the past!

In this stage, we visit an Indigenous Cat-Village! Help our newest feline friend, Moon, cure an ailing village and have fun finding those mischievous cats in two new scenarios!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SwhweWS.png[/img]

Also, we're running a survey to get your feedback and make our games even better. Your input is invaluable to us, and we'll share some of the questions and answers on our Discord in a special Q&A session. 

Check it out: https://forms.gle/SzUux72wu9WW8UyL6


The update for "An Arcade Full of Cats: Timewarp Trouble" is live now. We're also working on an update for the free version of the game, with another stage coming in 2024. ːpapyruswackyː
Hope you have fun! ːsansː

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: New Mode: Time Attack
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!

Prepare for a whisker-tingling experience as we introduce a hardcore addition to "An Arcade Full of Cats" - the TIME ATTACK MODE! ːwrycatː

In this mode, the game will feature a chronometer so you can track your time throughout the game. Feel the thrill of the chase as you speed through the game, aiming to set a new personal best time. 

It's a mode perfect for those trying to hone their skills in speedrunning "An Arcade Full of Cats", and it would not be complete without the accompanying leaderboard, allowing you to compare your times with players all around the globe!

The addition of this mode is a heartfelt thank you to you for making "An Arcade Full of Cats" a roaring success. And be sure there's more to come! ːwinkycatː


[h3][b]YOUR CAT IN OUR GAME!
[/b][/h3]
We also have news on our next release, "Cats Love Boxes," and ways you can support us beyond buying our games, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1961160/view/3870344877703247723]check it out[/url]!

notes.title: FREE Content Updates are Coming!
notes.notes:
Hello, hoomans!

W-O-W!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2wARsaW.png[/img]

We are beyond grateful to each and every one of you who has contributed to the success of An Arcade Full Of Cats. Your enthusiasm, encouragement and engagement have made this journey truly remarkable. Without your support, this would have been impossible. Thanks to each and every one of you! ːemotionalcatː

An Arcade Full of Cats was created as a labor of love: a gift to all of you who share a passion for cats and gaming. You can't imagine the joy we've been feeling to see so many of you sharing rescue stories and feline care while playing our games. It's absolutely amazing to see that our games resonate with so many hearts and cat lovers. That only inspires us to continue making games that raise awareness for cats, to help these little souls in a world that sometimes feels so hard to live in. ːfofinoː

As a token of our appreciation for the ongoing support you guys have been giving us, we'd like to announce that there'll be updates for AAFOC and "TimeWarp Trouble." Both the base game AND the DLC will receive a new stage each! 
These updates are scheduled for 2024 and will be provided to you for free! ːpapyruswackyː

Additionally, we'll be introducing a new game mode in 2 weeks, tailored for the more "hardcore" players out there. 
Don't worry! No achievements for the hardcore mode! ːsansː

Also, don't forget about our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2368470/view/3812920811263918439]Arcade Stick giveaway[/url] on our Discord channel! Join us in the festivities and stand a chance to win a fantastic prize. Winners will be revealed this thursday, November 23th.

One more thing: we've also made a post set for the [b]Steam Awards Nominations[/b]. You can check it out right now and nominate [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2368470/view/3907497581010673758][b]AN ARCADE FULL OF CATS[/b] for the [b]"Sit Back and Relax"[/b][/url] 2023 category. We need all the help we can get, every vote counts!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8k4jytK.png[/img]

Let's continue this journey together, with more adventures, more cats, more joy and love!
Thank you for being a crucial part of the An Arcade Full of Cats success. Your support means the world to us. ❤

Here's to the joy of gaming, the love of cats and the incredible bond we share. 

Love and Purrs, 
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello humans! ːcathspawː

We're thrilled to unveil an exciting new adventure! Introducing "An Arcade Full of Cats: Timewarp Trouble," an expansion that will be released on November 16th, alongside "An Arcade Full of Cats". 
This DLC is not just a thrilling addition to the base game but also a heartfelt celebration of a very special month for us. ːfofinoː

As November rolls around, it is time to celebrate two incredible anniversaries that hold a special place in our hearts: it marks the cherished moment when Fofiño and Leo entered our lives (2015 and 2022, respectively) – and it's also the anniversary of "A Castle Full of Cats"! ːfofino2ː

In order to celebrate this extra special time and to show our gratitude for everyone who embarked in this journey with us, we'll be giving "An Arcade Full of Cats" as a free game! It began as a small game, but it has grown beyond our expectations – the base game is even bigger than "A Building Full of Cats"! 


[b]"Timewarp Trouble" - An Adventure Like No Other[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2582360/An_Arcade_Full_of_Cats_TimeWarp_Trouble/

"An Arcade Full of Cats: Timewarp Trouble" offers a twist in the ideas of "An Arcade Full of Cats". In this expansion, Leo and Fofiño find themselves venturing too deep into the past, encountering cats from Pre-History, the Georgian Age, and the Old West. Your mission isn't just to search for lost cats; you'll also be running errands for cats from each era! Meet Joe, Louie and Lybica – they'll be your guides throughout this exciting adventure.

[b]Timewarp Trouble[/b] Features:

[list]
[*] [b]New Time Eras:[/b] Dive into Pre-History, the Georgian Age and The Old West, each with its unique challenges and adorable cats to rescue.

[*] [b]Time-Bending Tasks:[/b] Complete various errands for cats from different time periods, adding an exciting twist to your adventure.

[*] [b]Meet New Friends:[/b] Get to know Joe, Louie and Lybica – your companions on this time-travelling cat rescue mission.

[*] [b]Original Soundtrack: [/b]Immerse yourself in the captivating world of "Timewarp Trouble" with our new original music.
[/list]

Get ready to experience a time-travelling quest that will challenge your skills, touch your heart and make history one era at a time. "An Arcade Full of Cats: Timewarp Trouble" awaits your adventurous spirit!

Join us on November 16th and uncover hidden feline friends, conquer challenging tasks and rewrite cat history in the process! Just don't overdo it, ok? ːwinkycatː

Thank you for being part of our incredible community and we can't wait to share this new adventure with you!

Love & Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Demo Available Now!!!
